instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language
topic: News Responses, Books and Films Vocabulary

questions.question: The opener 'Did you read that story about…' belongs to...
options: giving a piece of the news
options_en: giving a piece of the news
questions.explanation: The question opens a topic by presenting a story, so it is the giving-news move.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال يفتح موضوعاً بعرض قصة، فهو خطوة تقديم الخبر.

questions.question: In 'You're kidding!', what is the speaker doing?
options: giving a piece of the news
options_en: giving a piece of the news
questions.explanation: You're kidding expresses surprise at what was just said, so it is a reaction.
questions.explanation_ar: You're kidding تعبّر عن المفاجأة مما قيل، فهي ردّ فعل.

questions.question: The follow-up 'Then what happened' belongs to...
options: giving a piece of the news
options_en: giving a piece of the news
questions.explanation: The question asks the speaker to continue the story, so it requests more detail.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال يطلب من المتحدث متابعة القصة، فهو طلب تفاصيل أكثر.

questions.question: In 'Apparently…', what is the speaker doing?
options: giving a piece of the news
options_en: giving a piece of the news
questions.explanation: Apparently introduces reported information, which is the giving-news function.
questions.explanation_ar: Apparently تقدّم معلومة منقولة، وهذه وظيفة تقديم الخبر.

questions.question: A family saga is a long story about...
options: a family across many long years
a police case from one town
a scientific idea from one lab
a short holiday in one place
options_en: a family across many long years
a police case from one town
a scientific idea from one lab
a short holiday in one place
questions.explanation: A saga follows one family across generations, so it covers many years.
questions.explanation_ar: الملحمة تتابع عائلة واحدة عبر الأجيال، فتغطي سنوات كثيرة.

questions.question: A thriller is a story that...
questions.explanation: A thriller is built on tension and suspense rather than facts or instruction.
questions.explanation_ar: رواية الإثارة مبنية على التوتر والتشويق لا على الحقائق أو التعليم.

questions.question: The setting of a book is...
questions.explanation: The setting is the place and time in which the story unfolds.
questions.explanation_ar: المكان والزمان هما البيئة التي تجري فيها القصة.

questions.question: The plot of a book is...
questions.explanation: The plot is the sequence of events that makes up the story.
questions.explanation_ar: الحبكة هي تسلسل الأحداث التي تشكّل القصة.

questions.question: It's based on a novel means...
questions.explanation: Based on means the film or play was developed from that source book.
questions.explanation_ar: based on تعني أن الفيلم أو المسرحية أُخذت من ذلك الكتاب.

questions.question: I couldn't put it down means...
questions.explanation: The phrase means the story was so gripping that the reader could not stop.
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة تعني أن الكتاب مشوّق لدرجة أن القارئ لا يستطيع تركه.

questions.question: In a news headline, plunge means...
questions.explanation: Headlines use plunge for a sharp drop in value or level.
questions.explanation_ar: العناوين تستخدم plunge للهبوط الحاد في القيمة أو المستوى.

questions.question: In the news story, nerd is...
questions.explanation: Nerd is a derogatory label for someone seen as a computer enthusiast.
questions.explanation_ar: nerd لفظ تحقيري لمن يُنظر إليه كمهووس بالحاسوب.
